title: Balcony grills: the trade-off between burglary risk and fire egress
text:
Owners and housing societies face a real trade-off: grills reduce burglary risk, but fixed grills block escape and rescue in a fire.
After a September 2021 apartment fire in Bengaluru, BBMP said balcony grilles added after the OC need its approval, citing building rules and the National Building Code 2016.
Mumbai's fire brigade chief has asked residents to keep only openable grills with a lock that can be broken during evacuation.
For buyers, this affects compliance and safety checks on resale flats, not just looks.
Sources: The News Minute (Sep 2021), Free Press Journal (Apr 2022).
Do your society's bye-laws say anything about openable grills?
